# `state/facts/Constraints.js`

> **Source:** `engine/state/facts/Constraints.js`

state/facts/Constraints.js — the laws of the system.  Layer law: runtime uses simple validators; commit uses stronger validators (a superset). A constraint never repairs — it accepts or rejects. When a commit constraint fails, the caller branches / quarantines / requests authority (see CommitGate, M5) rather than silently fixing.

## Functions

### `constraint(id, test, opts = {})`

Define a constraint.

**Parameters:**

- `id` *(string)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `test` *((liveFacts:Set<string>)=>boolean)* — true = legal
- `[opts]` *(object)* — { scope:'runtime'|'commit', message }

### `validateFacts(liveFacts, constraints, { phase = SCOPE_RUNTIME } = {})`

Validate live facts. phase 'runtime' runs only runtime constraints; phase 'commit' runs ALL (runtime + commit) — commit is strictly stronger.

**Returns:** > }}

### `atMostOne(id, pattern, opts = {})`

No more than one live fact matching a regex (single source of truth).

### `mutuallyExclusive(id, a, b, opts = {})`

Two facts must never be live at once (mutual exclusion).

## Constants

- `SCOPE_RUNTIME`
- `SCOPE_COMMIT`
